The present invention relates to the production process of biotin by fermentation using a genetically engineered microorganism, and DNA sequences and vectors to be used in such process.

Vitamin H biosynthesis gene IIThe present invention relates to utilize the genetically engineered organism to produce the method for vitamin H by fermentation.

Vitamin H is one of essential vitamin of animal, plant and microbial nutrition, and also is crucial for medicine or foodstuff additive.

Fully studied colibacillary vitamin H biosynthesizing, and illustrating vitamin H is through 7-ketone group-8-amino-nonanoic acid (KAPA), 7 from the pimelyl coenzyme A, 8-diaminopelargonic acid (DAPA) and desthiobiotin (DTB) synthetic [intestinal bacteria and Salmonellas, cell and molecular biology, 544, (1987)].The existing well progress of the genetic information analysis that the biosynthesizing of (United States Patent (USP) 5096823) and vitamin H is relevant on intestinal bacteria [journal of biological chemistry, 263,19577, (1988)] and bacillus albuminis.At least four kinds of enzymes that this biosynthetic pathway comprises have been known.These four kinds of enzymes are by bioA, bioB, bioD and bioF genes encoding.The catalysis of bioF genes encoding is converted into the pimelyl coenzyme A KAPA synthetic enzyme of KAPA.The bioA genes encoding transforms into KAPA the DAPA transaminase of DAPA.The bioD genes encoding transforms into DAPA the DTB synthetic enzyme of DTB.The bioB genes encoding transforms into DTB the vitamin H synthase of vitamin H.Also reported simultaneously and in intestinal bacteria, participated in pimelyl coenzyme A synthetic bioC and bioH gene.

Carried out the research that many fermentations produce vitamin H.Utilized intestinal bacteria (Japanese Patent disclose 149091/1986 and Japanese Patent disclose 155081/1987), bacillus albuminis (Japanese Patent discloses 180174/1991), serratia marcescens (Japanese Patent discloses 27980/1990) and Brevibacterium flavum (Japanese Patent discloses 240489/1991).But because their productivity is low, these methods also are not suitable for Industrial processes.In addition, a large amount of DTB (vitamin H precursor) accumulate in the fermentation of these bacteriums.Therefore, supposed that Biotin Operon final step (from DTB to the vitamin H) is a rate-limiting step.

On the other hand, find that the bacterial isolates that belongs to Kurthia produces DBT and a spot of vitamin H.And, from the wild type strain of Kurthia, isolate the mutant of generation large number of biological element by selection to the resistance of resistance, 5-(2-thienyl)-valerian acid (TVA) and the Alpha-Methyl desthiobiotin (MeDTB) of vitamin H metabolic antagonist acid enzyme element (ACM).Yet,, preferably use genetically engineered to improve the vitamin H output of this mutant in view of still low vitamin H value.

Therefore the present invention relates to carry the chromosomal dna fragment of the gene relevant with the biosynthesizing of Kurthia sp. vitamin H.This isolating chromosomal dna fragment carries bioA, bioB, bioC, bioD, bioF, bioFII, 8 genes such as bioH and bioHII and transcriptional regulatory sequences.The enzyme of bioFII genes encoding bioF gene product.

The invention still further relates to Kurthia sp. bacterial strain, wherein increased at least one and participated in the Biotin Operon gene, also relate to the method that produces vitamin H by genetically engineered Kurthia sp. bacterial strain simultaneously.
